package.description: Telegram Bot for Proxmox VE management

en-US.description: Telegram Bot for Proxmox VE management
en-US.longDescription:
cv4pve-botgram is a Telegram bot for managing Proxmox VE clusters.
It allows you to monitor and control your virtual machines and containers
through Telegram chat commands with secure authentication.

Features:
- Manage VMs and Containers via Telegram
- Secure chat ID-based authentication
- Real-time status monitoring
- Start/Stop/Reboot operations
- Node management commands
- API explorer for advanced operations
- Custom command aliases
- Service and console modes
en-US.name: cv4pve-botgram
